newsitem.title: FINLAND: Baltic Ice - Ice melting, some restrictions lifted.
newsitem.headline: Baltic Ice - Ice melting, some restrictions lifted.

text.p: Ice receded in the Bay of Finland and all restrictions for Finnish ports there were lifted, the Finnish Institute of Marine Research said in its twice-weekly ice report on Thursday.
Russian restrictions to navigation were unchanged, an official said by telephone.

The restriction to Vaasa was eased and vessels with ice classes IA or IB would only need 1,300 deadweight tonnes to be assisted and vessels with ice classes IC and II would be assisted if their deadweight was 2,000 tonnes, it said.

Four ice-breakers were in action near St Petersburg. Five were assisting in the northern end of the Gulf of Bothnia and two in the middle, and one remained on station outside Parnu in the Gulf of Riga, the institute said.(Temperatures of nearby isotherms, degrees Celsius)

NOTES: New ice - forming, thin and still moving. Fast ice - not moving level flat ice. Level ice - thick flat ice. Consolidated/compact - compact close ice. Windrow ice - reshaped by wind, thickness varies sharply. Rafted - ridges forming, 10-20 cm thick. Ridged - ridged or hummocked ice. Open - floes with water at rate of 4-6:10. Close ice - floes tightly packed.
